name: Ward-Torn Horror
description:
A Ward-Torn Horror is what remains when a protective oath dies screaming. Its body is a tall, humanlike ruin wrapped in shredded ward-cloth, lacquered strips, and cracked sigils burned directly into pale, desiccated flesh. Fragments of ceremonial masks and broken seal-plates cling to its shoulders and ribs like trophies from a failed rite, while thin lines of dim blue-white light pulse beneath torn skin as if the creature is still trying to hold itself together. One arm may end in a jagged mass of splintered stone and iron charms, the other in a claw of warped fingers inked with half-erased command marks. Its face is often hidden behind layers of stitched veils or a cracked visor, but when visible, the features are hollowed and wrong, with eyes that glow like a breach in a sealed vault.

It moves with the stiff, purposeful gait of a guard on duty, yet every step leaves a faint shimmer of broken warding in the air. Around it, lantern light dims, runes stutter, and nearby seals tremble as if recognizing a corrupted authority. The horror radiates a hush of pressure and dread, as though the room itself has been ordered to remain silent.
